subject: Follow-up: ops intake and scheduling dedicated sizing call
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@clearwave.com>, Clara Lopez <clara.lopez@clearwave.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0400
Subject: Follow-up: ops intake and scheduling dedicated sizing call

Hi Samir / Clara,

Thanks again for the call this morning — really helpful to see Clearwave's end-to-end flow and the production constraints. To recap briefly: you expect a bursty traffic profile with a high-volume window around payroll runs, want predictable P95 latency in the 1.5–2s range for model inference, and need an isolated, reserved pool (dedicated) with audit logging for compliance.

Next step from our side is to schedule a 60-minute technical deep dive + dedicated capacity sizing session where we can:
- Walk through your sample traffic (CSV) and live request patterns
- Map throughput/latency tradeoffs across model variants and quantization options
- Agree on autoscaling and burst policies for payroll windows

Proposed slots (all EDT):
- Tue 22 Jun, 10:00–11:00
- Tue 22 Jun, 14:00–15:00
- Wed 23 Jun, 09:00–10:00

I've attached a lightweight template for the traffic profile (clearwave_sample_traffic_20270620.csv) and a draft mutual action plan (MAP) so we can align action owners. Can you share which slot works (or paste availability) and whether your security/infra lead should join?

Thanks — looping in Ben (SE) and Priyom (Solutions) to join the sizing call.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: clearwave_sample_traffic_20270620.csv (text/csv), mutual_action_plan_draft.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
From: Samir Shah <samir@clearwave.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Clara Lopez <clara.lopez@clearwave.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: ops intake and scheduling dedicated sizing call

Thanks Olga — appreciated the clear summary.

We can do a 60-minute deep dive. A couple clarifications before we lock:
- Peak target: ~500 req/s sustained for ~10 minutes during payroll, typical baseline ~40 req/s.
- Latency target: P95 <= 2s for the main inference path (token streaming optional).
- We will want strict data isolation and audit trails (SOC2 controls) in Dedicated.

Our infra/security lead (Clara) should join the sizing portion. She may also ask about KMS integration and VPC setup.

From our side, Tue 22 Jun 14:00–15:00 PT (17:00–18:00 ET) actually works best — would that be your 14:00 EDT option? If not, we can do Tue 22 Jun 10:00 ET.

I attached an expanded slice of our traffic (gzip CSV) — I'll upload to the HubSpot file area but sending the sample may help you prep.

Thanks Samir — great, appreciate the detail. Tue 22 Jun 14:00 EDT (11:00 PDT) matches one of the slots we suggested; we'll lock that.

Ben / Priyom — can you both confirm availability to join Tue 22 Jun 14:00–15:00 EDT? Priyom, please bring the sizing worksheet and the preliminary mapping between model variant, batch sizes, and expected GPU footprint (we can use the MAP attachment to capture owners). Ben, would you lead the latency SLO discussion and bring the current benchmark numbers for the rtx-optimized path?

Samir / Clara — if you can upload the expanded traffic slice to the HubSpot file area (or send a Drive link) that will help Priyom prep. I'll send a calendar invite with the agenda and a shared doc for the run book.

Olga
